simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲרוּכָה (H724) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲרוּכָה (ʼărûwkâh) means wholeness (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 2Chr 24 13.

definitions.full: H724. arukah אֲרוּכָה noun feminine healing of a wound, restoration (properly the new flesh that grows at the wounded spot, Arabic ; Fi JPh xiii. 114-6 , so Fl De on Isa 58:8 ; see also Di) — ׳א 2Chr 24:13 ; Neh 4:1 ; אֲרֻכָה Jer 30:17 ; 33:6 ; construct אֲרֻכַת 8:22 ; אֲרֻכָֽתְךָ Isa 58:8 ; — alwaysfig. a. healing, restoration of Israel Isa 58:8 , here with verb צָמַח , elsewhere with עָלָה ; Jer 8:22 (|| רָפָא ), with עָלָה Hiph`il, subject ׳י , 30:17 ; 33:6 (|| id. ) b. restoration of walls of temple 2Chr 24:13 , of walls of Jerusalem (compare Fi above) Neh 4:1 (both with עלה ).
definitions.rootNote: or אֲרֻכָה ; feminine passive participle of 748 (in the sense of restoring to soundness);
